title: One Remarkable Feat that Stuns the World
next_chapter_hook: Just as Chen Ji thought everything had settled, a pitch-black crack suddenly tore open in the Nine Heavens. An eye covered in countless stars slowly opened from the depths of the crack, gazing down at this world with absolute indifference—and at Chen Ji, who had just reached the summit.

text.content: The three-day deadline passed in an instant. When the first rays of dawn pierced through the horizon, the skies above the Tianqing Sect Martial Arena were already filled with a dense crowd. Elders from the three major sects, Inner Disciples, Outer Disciples, and even some reclusive seniors who had not emerged for years—all had gathered at the news. Today was the Sect Competition finals of the Tianqing Sect, held once every decade. More precisely—it was the decisive battle between Chen Ji and the predetermined fate of the entire Tianqing Sect.

dialogue.content: (His palm slightly tightening, feeling the warmth of the formation core gifted by Su Qingyao) At the center of the Martial Arena, twelve dragon-carved pillars formed a formation, and the runes on their surfaces were lighting up visibly. Chen Ji stood in the shadows of the entrance passage, his gaze piercing through the crowd to precisely lock onto the figures on the high platform—Han Lie, grandson of the Grand Elder, stood with arms crossed, a disdainful smirk playing at the corners of his mouth; the Fifth Elder stood at the far end of the Elder seats, his turbid old eyes flickering with a hint of unnoticeable malevolence; while the old Sect Master of Tianqing Sect, Ling Yuan, wore an expression of serene indifference, as if today's match was merely a trivial pastime.

text.content: The waste is on stage! Someone shouted this first, followed immediately by bursts of laughter erupting from all sides of the Martial Arena. Everyone was pointing and mocking—the waste actually dared to enter the finals? I bet he won't even survive the first round! I heard the Fifth Elder specially set up a lethal formation. This time he's definitely dead! Chen Ji acted as if he heard nothing, walking slowly toward the center of the arena. His pace was unhurried, and there was even a faint smile on his face.

dialogue.content: Waste. Han Lie's voice, amplified by spiritual energy, echoed throughout the entire arena. He stepped forward, his aura surging toward Chen Ji like a violent tide. Today, I will teach you what it means to know the heights of heaven and the depths of the earth. With every word he spoke, the marble ground beneath his feet cracked further. The pressure from the Xuanwu Sect's number one genius was unleashed without any restraint, causing the surrounding disciples to retreat repeatedly. Yet Chen Ji acted as if he felt no pressure at all, even going so far as to yawn.

(Speaking calmly) Why so nervous, Senior Han? He tilted his head, his tone full of nonchalance. It's just a match, why make it seem like a life-and-death battle? The entire arena erupted in an uproar. Has this kid gone mad? How dare he speak to Han Lie like that! He's definitely dead, truly dead...

choice.prompt: The finals officially begin. Faced with Han Lie's full-powered strike, you choose:

choices.description: Without dodging or evading, crush Han Lie's attack with absolute strength, letting everyone witness the true power of the 'waste'
choices.visible_reward: The entire arena is shocked, the villains lose all face

text.content: Chen Ji moved. He didn't dodge, used no flashy techniques—simply threw out a single fist. BOOM—! The fist wind collided with Han Lie's killing blow in mid-air, erupting into a deafening roar. Dust scattered everywhere, rocks flew in all directions. When the dust settled, everyone witnessed a scene they would never forget—Han Lie, on his knees, hands supporting him on the ground, veins bulging on his forehead, blood trickling from the corner of his mouth. And Chen Ji, withdrawing his fist, his expression calm, as if he had just done something utterly insignificant.

choices.text: Feigning Weakness to Eat the Tiger
choices.description: Deliberately appear weak, letting Han Lie think he's dominating, then deliver a fatal strike at the most critical moment to maximize the humiliation
choices.visible_cost: Must endure some damage to deceive the opponent
choices.visible_reward: Humiliation effect doubled, Han Lie's psychology collapses
choices.risk_hint: May backfire if not controlled properly

text.content: Han Lie's attacks poured down like a violent storm, Chen Ji retreated step by step, seemingly only able to defend. The entire arena erupted in mocking laughter again—See, I told you he couldn't hold on! Truly the true colors of a waste! Han Lie coldly smiled: Is that all? However, just as his final strike was about to land—A flicker of amusement flashed in Chen Ji's eyes. Enough. He said softly, extending two fingers to gently pinch Han Lie's full-powered strike.

choices.description: Use Han Lie's own power to rebound on him, making him lose face in front of everyone while exposing the Fifth Elder's lethal formation trap
choices.visible_cost: Requires precise calculation of force and timing
choices.visible_reward: Kill two birds with one stone: Defeat Han Lie + Expose the conspiracy

text.content: Chen Ji sidestepped, using Han Lie's fierce attack to his advantage with a gentle deflection. The violent force was redirected toward an entirely different direction—straight toward Elder Five at the end of the Elder seats! Elder Five's face changed dramatically, hastily raising his guard to block. At that moment, Chen Ji's voice leisurely rang out: Elder Five, shouldn't you be taking down this killing formation? The entire arena was stunned. Killing formation? What killing formation? Elder Five's face instantly turned ashen.

Right at this moment, the twelve carved dragon pillars surrounding the Martial Arena suddenly illuminated! Blinding golden light shot upward, intertwining mid-air into an impenetrable net. A chilling aura surged from all directions, carrying suffocating killing intent. As expected, it was activated. Chen Ji's lips curved slightly—he had already foreseen this scene three days prior using the Tianji Record. Elder Five, this is your handiwork, isn't it? His voice was soft, yet it clearly reached everyone's ears.

dialogue.content:
(Seated high on the platform, gaze deep as an abyss)

The entire arena erupted in uproar.

Elder Five's face flushed crimson as he shouted sternly: Complete nonsense! This is the Sect Competition's protective sect formation—how dare you slander it!

Yet just then, a cold voice rang out from within the formation—

Elder Five, this formation... is by no means a protective sect formation.

Su Qingyao strode through the air, her elegant hand raised gently. A radiant blue formation's eye bloomed in her palm, presenting a stark contrast to the golden killing formation.

This is the 'Soul-Locking Death Formation' specifically designed to target Chen Ji—three days ago, I retrieved the true formation's core from your secret chamber.

text.content:
Evidence was irrefutable, proof was overwhelming.

Elder Five's face turned deathly pale, his body involuntarily recoiling.

Impossible... how could you possibly...

He murmured, his eyes filled with disbelief.

When he had set this killing formation, he believed it was done in absolute secrecy. He had meticulously destroyed all evidence of colluding with external enemies and harming fellow disciples.

Yet he never imagined—

Chen Ji not only knew everything in advance but had also prepared a counter-strategy.

dialogue.content:
Elder Five, there's something else I forgot to tell you.

Chen Ji's voice remained serene, yet sent Elder Five into an icy abyss.

Three days ago, the three assassins you sent to intercept me... their 'Soul-Devouring Powder' was personally refined by me.

Which means—

He paused, a mocking curve forming at the corner of his lips.

The poison you gave them cannot kill anyone. It will only cause them to become completely paralyzed within half an hour, completely at others' mercy.

Right now, they are waiting in the sect's Law Enforcement Hall, ready to 'testify' to your crimes.

choice.prompt: Elder Five's conspiracy is exposed. Faced with this traitor who betrayed the sect, you choose:

choices.description: Only partially expose the evidence, handing over the punishment authority to the sect. Avoid making too many enemies and preserve room for negotiation in the future.
choices.visible_cost: Elder Five may escape severe punishment.
choices.visible_reward: Those present grow even more wary of your calculated schemes.

text.content:
While the entire arena was shocked, they secretly admired Chen Ji's magnanimity.

Thistrash... no, this person, his thoughts are actually so profound!

Elder Five collapsed to the ground, trembling all over.

Ling Yuan, the former Sect Master, slowly rose from his seat, his gaze complex as he looked at Chen Ji—appreciation and wariness coexisting in those eyes.

Chen Ji, my nephew's grandson, this matter... will be thoroughly investigated.

He said heavily, his tone revealing nothing of his true emotions.

choices.description: Expose all evidence of Elder Five's collusion with external enemies before the entire sect, utterly cutting off his retreat.
choices.visible_cost: May offend the forces behind Elder Five.
choices.visible_reward: Establish your prestige across the arena—no one will dare to underestimate you again.

text.content:
Chen Ji didn't speak, simply retrieving a jade slip from his sleeve and gently crushing it.

Light and shadows materialized—the scene of Elder Five secretly negotiating with a masked figure!

The aura emanating from that black-clothed figure was unmistakably... the aura of a Holy Sect from the Demonic Path!

Colluding with the Demonic Path!

This is a capital offense!

Elder Five's face turned deathly pale, his legs buckling as he collapsed to the ground.

Chen Ji looked down at him imperiously, his voice cold as ice:

Those who betray the sect, die.

Today, I will not kill you.

But from this moment onward, you are no longer an elder of the Tianqing Sect, but... a criminal of the Tianqing Sect.

choices.description: Not only expose the crimes, but verbally crush Elder Five's psychological defenses, utterly humiliating him.

text.content:
Chen Ji chuckled lightly, his voice lingering悠悠回荡在演武场上空。

五长老，三年前收我为杂役弟子时曾言：trash就该有trash的觉悟，安分守己，或许还能苟延残喘。

今日，他一字一顿地重复这句话，笑意愈发icy——叛徒就该有叛徒的下场，安分伏法，或许还能留个全尸。

五长老浑身剧烈颤抖，不知是furious还是fearful。

全场鸦雀无声，所有人都被这一幕awestruck。

Just as everyone believed the competition had ended—

The sky suddenly changed dramatically!

The originally clear sky instantly darkened, a thick layer of dark clouds surging from all directions, shrouding the entire Martial Arena in an ominous gloom.

Gale winds howled, sand and stones flew everywhere.

The watching crowd cried out in alarm; those with lower cultivation were even forced backward by this overwhelming pressure.

Ling Yuan, the former Sect Master's face shifted drastically as he rose abruptly:

This is...

dialogue.content:
(Flies forward to block in front of Chen Ji, expression grave)

Su Qingyao's pupils constricted sharply.

The formation eye she took from her embrace was trembling violently, its ghostly blue light flickering intermittently, as if in fear of something.

Chen Ji, be careful...

Her voice carried a rare tremor.

This aura... I've never seen anything so terrifying...

Chen Ji did not answer.

He simply raised his head quietly, gazing toward the churning dark clouds—

For he knew, within those clouds, eyes were fixed upon him.

choice.prompt: The sky undergoes a strange transformation, the gaze of the Heavenly Dao's Eye is about to manifest—your choice:

choices.description: Fearlessly meet those eyes in a stare, declaring your unyielding determination through your aura
choices.visible_reward: Willpower increases, those present hold deeper reverence for you
choices.risk_hint: Facing the Heavenly Dao's Eye directly carries unknown risks

text.content:
Chen Ji walked forward step by step against that suffocating pressure.

His spine stood straight and resolute, his eyes showing no hint of retreat.

Just look then.

He said softly, the corner of his lips even curving into a faint arc.

Want to see Chen Ji's fate?

Then look your fill.

As his voice fell, from that crack, an eye slowly revealed itself—

It was an eye woven from stars and chaos, without pupil, without emotion—only endless coldness and a downward gaze.

choices.description: Remain calm, wait for the situation to develop, while secretly operating the Tianji Record, attempting to capture that fleeting connection
choices.visible_cost: Miss the opportunity for taking initiative
choices.visible_reward: May obtain key information about the Heavenly Dao's Eye
choices.risk_hint: Passive waiting may lead to a passive position

text.content:
Chen Ji did not move.

He simply stood still, allowing that pressure to envelop his entire body.

Meanwhile, he secretly operated the Tianji Record Fragment—

The Tianji Record warmed slightly, and a blurry image flashed through his mind:

It was an eye.

An eye that had been watching the mortal world since ancient times.

It was neither the eye of any person nor the eye of any being—

It was the eye of "Heaven's Way" itself.

Chen Ji's pupils constricted sharply.

choices.description: Disregarding personal safety, pull Su Qingyao into your embrace, using your body to shield her from that despair-inducing pressure
choices.visible_reward: The relationship with Su Qingyao undergoes a qualitative change, unlocking a hidden storyline

text.content:
Chen Ji moved.

He pulled Su Qingyao into his embrace in one swift motion, his wide robe completely enveloping her body.

Su Qingyao was frozen stiff, about to struggle, when Chen Ji's low voice came from above her head:

Don't move.

Her body instantly quieted.

For she felt it—Chen Ji's body was trembling slightly.

It wasn't fear.

It was the stubbornness of forcing himself not to collapse.

Chen Ji...

Her eyes, suddenly, grew moist.

Just then, the crack in the sky tore open completely!

That eye manifested fully—

It was composed of endless nebulae and chaos, spanning over a hundred zhang in diameter. Its "eye white" was a churning galaxy, its "pupil" a bottomless vortex, as if capable of devouring all creation.

The moment it gazed upon Chen Ji—

The entire Tianqing Sect trembled.

All disciples knelt simultaneously, trembling violently, not daring to lift their heads.

Only Chen Ji still stood firm in place.

His gaze locked with that eye, like two chess players silently confronting each other on the chessboard of fate.

(Low murmur in the heart: So this is how it is...)

Chen Ji finally understood.

From the moment he transmigrated to this world, he had been watched by these eyes.

The Tianji Record Fragment, the waste physique, all opportunities and crises—

They were all part of this chess game.

He thought he was playing chess, unaware—

He himself was merely a chess piece.

Just as his thoughts churned, that eye slowly blinked.

Then, a cold voice rang directly in his mind—

"Interesting."

"This one... has remembered you."

dialogue.content:
(Sits upright on the high platform, face as still as deep water)

Ling Yuan the old Sect Master's body trembled slightly.

He recognized that eye.

Decades ago, when he was a young disciple, he had seen its image in a broken ancient book—

The Heavenly Dao's Eye.

The legendary materialized form of Heavenly Dao's will.

Every time it appeared, it meant the world's pattern was about to undergo a great change.

And this time...

Its gaze had actually locked onto an outer disciple.

A complex light flickered in Ling Yuan's eyes—wariness, fear, and a hint of... wild joy?

text.content:
The Heavenly Dao's Eye gazed at Chen Ji for a full three breaths of time.

In those three breaths, Chen Ji felt his very soul exposed—

All his secrets, all his schemes, all his disguises were laid bare before those cold, indifferent eyes.

Yet Chen Ji did not retreat.

He even curved his lips, revealing a faint smile.

Want to see me?

Then look.

Someday—

His gaze suddenly turned sharp.

I will knock you off the chessboard, and see then—

who gazes upon whom.

As if hearing his words, that Heavenly Dao's Eye blinked once more.

Then, it slowly closed and vanished into the nine heavens.

The sky restored to clearness, as if nothing had happened.

But everyone knew—

Everything had changed.

Chen Ji stood in the center of the Martial Arena, bathed in the restored sunlight. Behind him lay the fallen Fifth Elder, the stunned Han Lie, and the entire crowd kneeling.

From this moment—

The name "waste" was utterly shattered.

Tianqing Sect's number one outer disciple, Chen Ji.

Truly deserved.

dialogue.content:
(Walking up to Chen Ji, voice lowered extremely)

Su Qingyao looked at the man before her, her eyes filled with complex emotions.

She still couldn't see through him.

But one thing she could be certain of—

This man was by no means some nobody.

She gently grasped his hand and slipped something into his palm.

This is...?

Chen Ji lowered his gaze—a smooth, warm Jade Pendant, with a small character "青" carved upon it.

Su Qingyao turned her face away, the tips of her ears flushed red:

It's nothing... just... thank you for protecting me just now.

Next time, let me protect you.

text.content:
(A faint smile curving at the corner of his lips)

Very well.

Chen Ji did not refuse, tucking the Jade Pendant into his chest.

Just then, an aged voice descended from the high platform—

Chen Ji, my nephew.

Elder Ling Yuan rose slowly, his gaze deep and profound as it fell upon him.

Today's matter, I shall investigate to the very end. But before that—

He paused, his tone carrying an added layer of profound meaning.

Would you be willing to follow me to the Back Mountain for a private word?

The entire arena erupted in whispers.

The Elder himself had summoned an Outer Disciple?

Chen Ji's expression remained unchanged, yet wariness surged within his heart.

He knew—the real game... was only just beginning.
